newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Chittagong port shut by workers' strike.
newsitem.headline: Chittagong port shut by workers' strike.

text.p: Bangladesh's main port of Chittagong was forced to shut as nearly 22,000 dock workers staged a wildcat strike against the handling of cargo by a private shipping firm.

Port officials said on Saturday the workers went on strike after the government-run Chittagong Port Authority allowed Q.C. Shipping Ltd to use its own equipment, under a privatisation policy adopted recently.

Permission to use the equipment was withdrawn with a view to ending the strike, but the stalemate continued after the owner of the company and a powerful opposition parliament member, Salahuddin Quader Chowdhury, refused to withdraw it.
The port officials said Chittagong Mayor A.B.M. Mohiuddin Ahmed, a ruling Awami League leader, was to hold a meeting with the strikers to try to end the stoppage later on Sunday.
They said at least 23 ships had been stranded due to the strike.
